verdict.rationale: Anytype has its own developer portal with a versioned API reference, a published OpenAPI v2 spec, a changelog, and featured examples such as the MCP integration. It also ships a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, a headless CLI, and the repo describes it as extensible through a gRPC API. These are documented integration surfaces for building external tools, but the evidence shows no in-app plugin or extension system or plugin SDK. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API or SDK, plugin-specific samples and docs, and independent corroboration of developers building extensions.
